output.scope_note: The paper is a computational screening study of lithium superionic conductors and reports ionic conductivity numbers, but only one value is cleanly attributable to a named material in the text; the AIMD values in Table 1 are scrambled in the PDF text, so their row alignment could not be verified and they were not extracted.

records.evidence_quote: Yet, in experiments, the ionic conductivity of the LiAlSiO4 thin film was approximately 2.7 × 10−5 mS/cm.
records.notes: Experimental value for a LiAlSiO4 thin film taken from earlier work (ref. 32), cited in the paper for comparison with the AIMD prediction; not measured in this paper. Temperature not stated.
